value.rationale: Short-edge matchings are a mathematically motivated and explicitly used construction in the odd-alphabet global metric enumeration of Mubayi–Terry. The fixed-base pair-spectrum separates local and long-distance geometric constraints, gives an exact all-matching-size classification, and exhibits a nontrivial separated-short-witness concentration. The limiting distance proportions 25:144:144 and mean feasible-distance constant 313/144 differ from the natural all-distance-three equilateral-base benchmark. These are specific structural model-theoretic invariants with immediate use in testing joint type compatibility, not merely arbitrary small numeric table entries.
